description.p: Seamstress is a garment creation tool: draw flat pattern pieces, sew their edges together and drape the result on an avatar with a cloth simulation.

ul.li: 2D pattern editor with sewing, and a 3D view of the sewn garment
Per-garment simulation with adjustable fabric physics
Layers, undo and redo, UV layout and texel density preview
Export to OBJ, glTF and FBX, and directly into MakeHuman's clothes library
